sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Anthropic's expected mega-IPO dominates the day as Wall Street tests investor appetite for a leading AI firm, while the only other fresh signal is a New York City Council hearing on AI whistleblowers.

sections.title: Anthropic expected to pursue mega IPO despite market uncertainty
sections.content: CNN reports that Wall Street is gearing up for Anthropic's expected mega initial public offering, described as a major test of investors' appetite for one of the AI industry's leading firms. The report notes that just weeks ago, its CEO... (the supplied description is truncated).
sections.significance: An IPO by a leading AI developer would be a major market test for the sector and a defining corporate event for Anthropic.
sections.transition_hint: The IPO story centers on Anthropic's corporate trajectory, while the next event shifts to regulatory scrutiny of AI firms including Anthropic at a New York City Council hearing.

sections.title: New York City Council hearing on AI whistleblowers with major AI companies
sections.content: Bloomberg reports that former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon, who warned that artificial intelligence could become too powerful for humans to control, will testify Monday at a New York City Council hearing alongside representatives of some of the world's biggest AI companies. The headline names Google, OpenAI, and Meta as facing the council.
sections.significance: A public legislative hearing featuring a former frontier-lab researcher and major AI companies signals growing municipal-level scrutiny of AI safety and whistleblower concerns.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The next evidence to watch is whether Anthropic's expected IPO is formally confirmed and how the New York City Council hearing's testimony shapes regulatory attention on frontier AI labs.
